newsitem.title: LATVIA: COMMERCIAL BANK EYES MORE CREDIT CARD BUSINESS.
newsitem.headline: COMMERCIAL BANK EYES MORE CREDIT CARD BUSINESS.

text.p: Riga Commercial Bank, Latvia's third largest bank, said on Wednesday that it had sold 4,000 Visa cards and hoped to distribute another 2,000 during 1997.
"The bank has recently approved its card business strategy and we hope to increase the number of clients with Visa cards by another 2,000 this year," spokesman Juris Punculs told Reuters.
"Riga Commercial Bank provides Visa Classic, Electron and Gold to private persons and Visa business cards to legal entities," the bank said in a statement.
The bank's spokesman also said the bank plans to install some 500 point-of-sale terminals and 15 bank machines in 1997.
"We will start with Riga and then follow Commercial Bank's existing network in all the major industrial centres of Latvia," Punculs said.
